```artifact
Decision Table 1: Edit/Update Chemist/Labs Screen
| Condition 1: Chemist/Lab Id Exists | Condition 2: Chemist/Lab Name | Condition 3: Address | Condition 4: Contact Details | Action |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------|----------------------|-----------------------------|--------|
| Yes                                | -                            | -                    | -                           | Display and modify details |
| No                                 | -                            | -                    | -                           | Display error: "Chemist or Lab does not exist" |

Decision Table 2: Delete Chemist/Lab Details
| Condition 1: Open Prescription Requests | Action |
|----------------------------------------|--------|
| Yes                                    | Display error: "Chemist or Lab has open Prescription Requests - cannot delete" |
| No                                     | Delete Chemist/Lab details |

Decision Table 3: Add Symptom Code Screen
| Condition 1: Symptom Code | Condition 2: Symptom Description | Action |
|---------------------------|----------------------------------|--------|
| Unique                    | -                                | Add Symptom Code |
| Duplicate                 | -                                | Display error: "Symptom Code already exists" |

Decision Table 4: Edit/Update Symptom Screen
| Condition 1: Symptom Code Exists | Condition 2: Symptom Description | Action |
|----------------------------------|----------------------------------|--------|
| Yes                              | -                                | Display and modify details |
| No                               | -                                | Display error: "Symptom does not exist" |

Decision Table 5: Update Patient Profile
| Condition 1: Valid Username/Password | Action |
|--------------------------------------|--------|
| Yes                                  | Capture and update Patient Id, Name, Age, Sex, Address, Contact details |
| No                                   | Display error: "Invalid username or password" |

Decision Table 6: Raise Consultation/Appointment Request
| Condition 1: Patient Profile Exists | Action |
|-------------------------------------|--------|
| Yes                                 | Raise Consultation/Appointment Request |
| No                                  | Display error: "Patient profile does not exist" |

Decision Table 7: Generate Prescription Reports/Print Invoice
| Condition 1: Prescription Exists | Action |
|----------------------------------|--------|
| Yes                              | Generate Prescription Report and Print Invoice |
| No                               | Display error: "No prescription available for reporting" |
```
